items.problem: Data-bound NavigationView shells can highlight later items while leaving the first Frame page visible.
items.evidence: migration-score.json: 2/3 scenarios fail; final MainPage.xaml nests NavigationViewItem in MenuItemTemplate and the ItemInvoked handler depends on its DataContext.
items.root_cause: The skill's recipe omitted the content-only template precondition, and validation had no structural gate for the known silent anti-pattern.
items.change: Correct the complete data-bound XAML/C# recipe and make Validate-UwpMigration fail when MenuItemsSource is combined with a MenuItemTemplate containing NavigationViewItem.
items.expected_effect: The recommended shell produces one generated item container, and the exact first-page-sticks structure cannot pass final validation.
items.falsifiable_check: The prior migrated MainPage.xaml is reported as a navigation-structure failure at its MenuItemTemplate; a content-only TextBlock template produces no hit.

items.problem: A project namespace can shadow the WinRT type demonstrated by the sample and produce misleading CS0234 member errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3106-3108: Package.Current bound to namespace Package in all three pages.
items.root_cause: Existing collision guidance covered ambiguous imported types but did not clearly cover current-namespace precedence.
items.change: Add the CS0234 namespace-shadow form and a descriptive WinRT type-alias fix beside the existing collision guidance.
items.expected_effect: Agents resolve this compiler diagnostic directly without renaming the project or repeatedly patching call sites.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the first build contains no CS0234 for Current under a project namespace matching a WinRT type.
items.tier_justification: The compiler already provides the non-ignorable Tier 1 signal; prose is the appropriate mapping from that diagnostic to the migration-specific fix.

items.problem: WinUI scaffold defaults added Settings and custom desktop chrome absent from the source shell.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json Application shell layout-difference and migrated MainWindow/MainPage XAML.
items.root_cause: General fidelity rules did not explicitly identify synthetic NavigationView defaults and scaffold chrome as redesign.
items.change: Strengthen shell invariants to disable absent Settings UI, remove scaffold-only title bar/backdrop/icon chrome, and preserve source pane/content proportions.
items.expected_effect: Migrated shells retain source navigation destinations and visual hierarchy instead of template defaults.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, no Settings item appears unless present in the UWP source, and no custom title bar/backdrop is added when absent from the source.
items.tier_justification: A static tool cannot infer whether a source app intentionally had Settings or custom chrome without becoming a parity evaluator; this remains a judgement rule.
